company.description: Kased Khair is a construction and general‑supplies contractor active in infrastructure, civil construction, and marine projects. It provides general contracting for civil works, industrial facilities, roads, steel structures, and integrated projects. The company also supplies machinery and executes marine, dredging, and electromechanical works. It focuses on large‑scale public and private infrastructure contracts in the Middle East and North Africa.
